definition: Too powerful or extraordinary to be expressed in words.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
quote: At last the tapping recommenced, and, to our indescribable joy and gratitude, died slowly away again until it ceased to be heard.
example_sentence: The relief when the last train finally arrived was indescribable.
